answer: One concrete mechanism: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. An identity earns only when its ledge recurs, its umber survives audit, and a trellis from an unlinked peer confirms it.
